verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a Zero Data Retention feature that lets users delete all data associated with completed tasks, which is a first-party deletion control. It is gated to enterprise plans, and the evidence is a single thin doc mention with no detail on retention periods, granular or per-task deletion, or browser-profile data handling. Missing for 10: availability outside enterprise plans, configurable retention windows, granular deletion APIs, profile/session data deletion details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
